description: Free export: a 720p, 16:9 MP4 with a small watermark and a 2.5-second end card. It renders on the user's own computer inside the widget (about as long as the song), so this tool shows the widget and starts the export there; the user downloads the MP4 from the widget when it finishes. If their ChatGPT app can't render video, the widget offers to open the project in their browser instead.
name: export_video
title: Export video
